preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree s is between 2 and 105, inclusive.
The nodes ai and bi are connected by an edge, where 1 ≤ i ≤ n - 1.
The input graph is a tree, meaning it is connected and has no cycles.

postconditions.expression: m is the number of nodes in the optimal T-decomposition
postconditions.description: The output contains the number of nodes m in the optimal T-decomposition.

postconditions.expression: Each line contains the description of a node xi in the T-decomposition
postconditions.description: The output contains m lines, each describing a node xi of the T-decomposition.

postconditions.expression: Each description starts with ki, the number of nodes in the initial tree s contained in xi
postconditions.description: The first integer in each line is the number of nodes from the initial tree contained in the corresponding T-decomposition node.

postconditions.expression: Each description is followed by ki distinct integers
postconditions.description: The following integers are the node indices from the initial tree contained in the corresponding T-decomposition node.
The output contains m - 1 lines, each with two integers representing edges between nodes in the T-decomposition.
The output represents an optimal T-decomposition with the minimum number of nodes.
